title: Speedy Chinese Vegan 'Chicken' Noodles
subtitle: with Pak Choy and Sesame Brittle
description: Five easy steps, minimal pans and prep… we cut the fluff but not the flavour in our speedy recipes. In just 20 minutes, you’ll have this masterpiece on the table and be crowned in glory too!

steps.text: Bake sesame brittle: Preheat the oven to 220C, fan-forced. Line an oven tray with baking paper. Bring a medium saucepan of water to the boil for the noodles. Put the sesame seeds and 1 tbs sugar on the lined tray and toss to combine (see Make it yours). Bake, stirring and flattening the mixture halfway, for 11-12 mins until golden. Set aside to cool completely, then break into small chunks.

Prep ingredients: Meanwhile, halve the carrot lengthwise and thinly slice on an angle. Quarter the pak choy lengthwise. Combine the Chinese barbecue seasoning, stir-fry sauce and 60ml (¼ cup) water in a bowl. Lightly season with salt and pepper.
Cook noodles: Cook the noodles in the pan of boiling water for 7 mins or until tender. Drain, then rinse under hot water to prevent the noodles from sticking.

Cook chicken-style strips: While the noodles are cooking, heat 1 tbs vegetable oil in a medium frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the plant-based chicken-style strips, carrot and pak choy, stirring occasionally, for 5-7 mins until the chicken-style strips are browned and warmed through.

Serve up: Add the noodles and sauce mixture to the chicken-style strips mixture and toss to combine. Remove from the heat. Taste, then season with salt and pepper. Divide the noodle mixture among bowls. Scatter over the sesame brittle and enjoy!
Make it yours: The sesame brittle adds a delicious crunch and sweetness to this dish, but you can skip this step if you prefer. Instead, simply scatter with the sesame seeds before serving.
